approvals.reason: Owner decision to run RTMPose-s (body7) for person-down and fence-climbing detection. Code and weights are Apache-2.0 (OpenMMLab MMPose, ONNX export by the project). The training mix includes datasets with non-commercial or research terms (AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18); under the owner's training-data policy of 2026-10-05 this is accepted by the owner, who bears the risk. The research recommended Indian legal advice, which has not been taken. The result is advisory: pose never changes an alarm by itself.
